# LucidAccuracy

> LucidAccuracy is a global workforce, technology and AI solutions company helping organizations worldwide build teams, solve technology challenges and automate business operations.

LucidAccuracy serves organizations in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, Europe and India. It has U.S. offices in Sacramento (California), Glastonbury (Connecticut) and Canton (Ohio). Contact: Info@lucidaccuracy.com, +1 307-999-9564.

## Solutions

- [Recruitment & Workforce Solutions](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/recruitment-workforce/): Permanent recruitment, contract staffing, temporary and flexible workforce, executive and specialized hiring, workforce management, recruitment process support and talent acquisition support.
- [Technology Solutions](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/technology/): Software and application development, cloud, data and analytics, AI and automation, cybersecurity, digital transformation and managed IT support.
- [Training & Professional Development](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/training/): Corporate training, technology training, upskilling and reskilling, professional development and certification support.
- [Consulting & Professional Services](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/consulting/): Workforce consulting, technology consulting and business transformation.
- [Business Process Solutions](https://lucidaccuracy.com/solutions/business-process/): Back-office operations, customer support, process management and business support.

## Products

- [LucidAI Calling Agent](https://lucidaccuracy.com/ai-calling-agent/): An AI voice agent that automates inbound and outbound phone conversations: lead qualification, appointment scheduling, answering frequently asked questions, automated follow-ups and call reporting, available 24/7.
